browser_capture_duration_backpressure.result: Four exact-commit Playwright cases passed: <1 second capture is rejected without upload; the accelerated clock confirms capture remains active at 6 and 20 minutes and stops at 30 minutes; simulated device disconnect retains a partial file and does not auto-submit; slowed IndexedDB persistence triggers the queue cap and preserves a recovery prefix bounded to 12 MiB. The 9 MiB upload case also confirms 4 MiB chunk offsets and interrupted-response resume.

runtime.runner: Playwright 1.64.1, headless Chromium 157, Node 22.16.0, local loopback frontend/API
limitations: Elapsed durations used Playwright's accelerated clock; no 30-minute wall-clock microphone recording was made.
Microphone and device-disconnect behavior used Chromium's synthetic audio device; physical hardware and channel integrity were not tested.
